{{Youmay|the epic poem "Defense of Naboo" by [[Omar Berenko/Legends|Omar Berenko]]|the [[Battle of Ohma-D'un]], also known as the Defense of Naboo|linebreak=1}}
{{Otheruses|Naboo}}
'''"Defense of Naboo"''',<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> or '''''The Defense of Naboo'''''<ref name="Darth Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> was an epic poem by [[Omar Berenko/Legends|Omar Berenko]], composed in the [[Room of Morning Mists/Legends|Room of Morning Mists]] while the poet stayed at [[Varykino/Legends|Varykino]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] centuries before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]. The poem was said to have been a disturbing yet visionary work. It was written in the [[Naboo (language)|Naboo]].
